title: Bootstrap 6 Auth Pages — 8 Free Login & Sign-up Templates
excerpt: Eight free Bootstrap 6 authentication pages — sign in, register, forgot and reset password, two-factor, magic link, SSO and a lock screen.
yoastTitle: Bootstrap 6 Auth Pages — 8 Free Login & Sign-up Templates
yoastDesc: Eight free Bootstrap 6 login and sign-up page templates covering the whole account journey — 2FA with the new OTP input and registration with the password Strength meter.
intro: A pack of eight Bootstrap 6 authentication screens covering the whole account journey — sign in, register, forgot password, reset, two-factor verification, passwordless magic link, SSO and a lock screen. Each is a standalone page you can lift the markup straight out of.
note: Two of these were genuinely awkward in Bootstrap 5. Two-factor verification uses v6’s new OTP input, with per-character boxes, paste handling and one-time-code autofill; registration and password reset use the new Strength meter, which fills as the password improves. Neither needed a third-party plugin.
summary: Bootstrap 6 Auth Pages is a pack of eight authentication screens: classic sign in, registration with the password Strength meter, forgot password, set a new password, two-factor verification built on the new OTP input, passwordless magic link, SSO with provider buttons and a workspace Combobox, and an idle lock screen. All use native :user-invalid validation via data-bs-validate. ESM-only, no build step, full light and dark mode.
features: Eight authentication screens, each on its own page with prev/next navigation
Classic sign in with adorned email input and remember-me
Registration using Bootstrap 6's new password Strength meter
Forgot password and set-new-password, the two halves of a reset flow
Two-factor verification built on the new OTP input, with one-time-code autofill
Passwordless magic-link sign in with an inline sent state
SSO screen with provider buttons and a searchable workspace Combobox
Idle lock screen that keeps the identity and asks only for the password
Full dark mode via data-bs-theme, remembered across visits
ESM-only vanilla JavaScript — no jQuery, no bundler, no build step
